title: Swiss/International
content: Apply Swiss/International Typographic Style with mathematical precision. Use strict grid systems for layout. Typography: Helvetica, Univers, or Akzidenz-Grotesk only. Left-aligned, flush-left ragged-right text. Objective photography without manipulation. Minimal color - mostly black, white, with one accent. Strong visual hierarchy through size and weight. Generous white space. Information-focused, no decorative elements. Clean, rational, universal design.

variants.simple: Create clean Swiss typography design with grid systems, sans-serif fonts, and objective clarity.

variants.advanced: Apply Swiss/International Typographic Style (1950s-60s Swiss design movement). Grid system: strict modular grid, use CSS Grid with precise column definitions (12-column or custom), consistent gutters, baseline grid for typography. Typography: Helvetica Neue, Univers, Akzidenz-Grotesk - no serifs, no decorative fonts. Text settings: flush-left ragged-right alignment (text-left), no justified text, generous line-height (leading-relaxed), tight tracking for headlines (tracking-tight). Hierarchy: establish clear levels through size scale only (not decorative means) - display, headline, subhead, body, caption. Photography: objective, documentary style, no filters or manipulation, full-bleed or precisely grid-aligned. Color: primarily black (#000) and white (#fff), single accent color if needed, avoid gradients. White space: generous, intentional, as important as content. Layout: asymmetric balance, content aligned to grid intersections, mathematical proportions. No decoration: every element is functional, remove anything without purpose. Information design: charts, diagrams, infographics with Swiss precision. Numbering and systems: clear organizational systems, proper use of bullets and numbering. Modern implementation: CSS custom properties for type scale, strict spacing tokens. Accessibility: extreme clarity benefits all users, high contrast, logical reading order.
